title: Dead pets dumping in Bulacan: Senators seek tougher measures; probe set
summary: MANILA, Philippines – Several senators are seeking to strengthen existing laws against animal cruelty as they condemned the dumping of the remains of several animals in San Jose Del Monte, Bulacan.…
